topics.topic: Capability/ownership for reading operation, binding, and contract metadata (including effect-class semantics) needed by flows/effects at proof and send time
questions: Which module is the source of the runtime operation facts needed to build/send (method, path, required headers, api_base_url, instance class) after staleness is checked, given that `OperationBinding` does not store all of them?

How should `effects` implement A10 class-dependent behavior (`draft-write` special case, `destructive` cannot be granted, approval-required classes) if effect-class comparison/order is said to be read by `flows` alone?
How do flows and effects obtain binding content (ports/classes/effect class) without bypassing bindings ownership?
Through which module capability does flows read contract-version ports/schemas/classes needed for proof?

topics.topic: Ownership of EffectAttempt attempt metadata derivation (idempotency_key and attempt_number) between effects and store
questions: Which module computes the idempotency-key value that is stored in M26, and from which exact pre-send data object is it derived?
Who is the source of truth for attempt_number on operation conclusions: does store assign it, or does effects supply it and store only validate?

topics.topic: Ownership and enforcement of persistent token-refusal state after A16 token-list re-read failure
questions: When A16 rule 2 re-read fails, which module owns and persists the "refuse every request (including owner) with the same token refusal" state, and how is that enforced on each request without duplicating A16 logic?

topics.topic: Ownership and persistence strategy for run-output reasons like skipped_by_guard/not_produced
questions: Which module owns computing these per-output reasons, and are they persisted or computed on read?

topics.topic: Required ordering model when an operation NodeExecution and derived non-executable records are created together
questions: Does A15 ordering for records that become non-executable together require a single total order including the operation node's own NodeExecution, or is separate ordering per write-call acceptable?

topics.topic: Selection rule for which FlowActivation record a draft-write EffectAttempt must reference
questions: If one flow version has multiple FlowActivation records over time, which exact FlowActivation record must a run's draft-write EffectAttempt reference?

topics.topic: Startup responsibility for identifying and deleting ended-run spool directories
questions: At startup, who is responsible for determining which ended runs' spool directories must be removed under A14/A18: `store.open_store` independently, or only `runs.recover_running_runs` via explicit naming?
